# fw workflow

> Reference of the fw workflow command: Run a built-in workflow (discover, abliterate-e2e, pkg-audit, perf-check). Usage, aliases and flags.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/workflow/

Run a built-in workflow (discover, abliterate-e2e, pkg-audit, perf-check)

## Usage

```bash
fw workflow <list|run> [discover|abliterate-e2e|pkg-audit|perf-check] [dir]
```

## Aliases

`fw wf` runs `fw workflow`.

## Subcommands

```bash
fw workflow list
fw workflow run
```

The names come from the usage line.
